$comment: TrustLens formal negative-indicator & suppression library (WP3, closes G-07). Authoritative home for negative (SUPPRESSIVE) indicators, replacing the NEGATIVE half of indicator-registry-v0.json. Consumed by the validators and deterministic rule runtime. Numeric score-reduction magnitudes are NOT defined here - they are deferred to DET-001 (CONF-001); effects here are ordinal/categorical.
provenance: Authored from the inverse of verified official guidance (SRC-004/006/021 et al.) and the ADR-0015 evidence hierarchy. Evidence-class/strength/effect assignments are HEURISTIC programme judgements (G-07).

change_history.change: Authored as part of the G-07 formal negative-indicator library (WP3).

PATCH (KB-001 §8: clarified description / metadata; no change to any indicator's interpretation). Rewrote resolution_order to the authoritative P3-WP3 override order (structural occurrence eligibility -> raw structurally-eligible live-positive set -> hard-risk overrides -> override-blockable soft suppressors -> CONTEXT_ONLY), removing the contradictory 'overrides computed on the reduced set' wording; added a structural_semantics statement that negation/reported/quoted/hypothetical attribution is non-overridable. No indicator id, suppression_effect, suppresses_indicators target, category, evidence, source_basis or override changed.

PATCH (KB-001 §8: clarified description / metadata; no change to any indicator's interpretation). Reconciled resolution_order to the programme-approved P3WP3-006 execution order: hard-risk OVERRIDES are computed FIRST from the raw structurally-eligible live positives, and the governed SUPPRESS_INDICATOR effect is then EXECUTED at the WP3 pre-match stage (driving a target operand to FALSE before the required combination), blocked only by an EXPLICITLY override-blockable flag. Separated structural occurrence semantics (non-overridable, sourced from observation.schema.json via observation_refs) from the governed SUPPRESS_INDICATOR library effect. No indicator id, suppression_effect, blockable_by_overrides value, suppresses_indicators target, category, evidence, source_basis or override changed.

MAJOR (KB-001): governed semantic change approved by programme authority. SUPPRESS_INDICATOR is occurrence-associated through governed observation_refs, not input-global. An active suppressor sets only an associated target-positive occurrence FALSE; explicitly disjoint occurrences do not interact; an unresolved association yields UNKNOWN rather than global FALSE. Occurrences for one indicator still combine by three-valued OR. Structural NEGATED/REPORTED/QUOTED/HYPOTHETICAL/non-live DESCRIPTIVE observations remain independently authoritative and non-overridable before suppression. This is a programme-level deterministic safety decision addressing ambiguous/global suppression, not a newly sourced fraud fact; source_basis and evidence assignments are unchanged.

categories.EDUCATIONAL_SAFETY: Scam-awareness / safety guidance: warns the user, does not instruct them.
categories.CUSTOMER_SUPPORT_SAFETY: Official 'we will never ask for X' support language.
categories.LEGIT_SERVICE_COMMS: Ordinary bank/service communication: notifications, official-channel redirects, no credential request.
categories.LEGIT_PAYMENT_DIRECTION: A clearly legitimate outbound payment direction (paying a known merchant).
categories.IT_SUPPORT: A legitimate, user-expected IT-support context with no banking/payment fraud signals.
categories.USER_INITIATED: The user themselves initiated the action (only trustworthy if the context model can observe it).
categories.ALLOWLIST_DOMAIN: A verified/allowlisted domain context. Weak by design; never cancels a hard-risk pattern.
categories.REPORTED_SCAM: The user is reporting/quoting scam wording, not receiving a live instruction.
categories.NEGATION_DIRECTIONAL: A directional negation that neutralises associated occurrences of a specific positive indicator through governed observation_refs ('do NOT share your OTP').
categories.BENIGN_CONTEXT: Weak benign context (low amount, no urgency). Adds evidence; never cancels alone.

suppression_effects.SUPPRESS_RULE: Cancels the whole matched rule (unless a hard-risk override is active).
suppression_effects.SUPPRESS_INDICATOR: Neutralises only associated occurrences of specific positive indicator(s), linked through governed observation_refs, before the rule is evaluated. Explicitly different occurrences are unaffected; unresolved association is UNKNOWN, never global FALSE. Not blocked by overrides unless explicitly declared blockable.
suppression_effects.CAP_SEVERITY: Caps the fired rule's severity to an ordinal ceiling; does not cancel.
suppression_effects.CONTEXT_ONLY: Records benign context; never changes the finding. (No numeric score-reduction here — REDUCE magnitudes are deferred to DET-001, CONF-001.)

resolution_order: 1. STRUCTURAL OCCURRENCE ELIGIBILITY (non-overridable). Derived from the normalized observation contract only (observation.schema.json status/polarity/attribution/mood), reached via indicator_observation.observation_refs. An occurrence is a LIVE first-party directive only when its backing observation status is OBSERVED and it is AFFIRMED + FIRST_PARTY + non-DESCRIPTIVE; a NEGATED/REPORTED/QUOTED/HYPOTHETICAL/DESCRIPTIVE occurrence, or a NOT_OBSERVED/NOT_APPLICABLE backing, is structurally non-live and NEVER projects to a live positive; UNKNOWN/AMBIGUOUS backing (or an unresolvable association) is UNRESOLVED (the operand stays UNKNOWN — never guessed live nor guessed benign). This is a semantic property of the occurrence, NOT a negative-library effect, and cannot be overridden.

2. RAW LIVE-POSITIVE SET. The structurally-eligible, confidence-gated live positives form the raw set. This is what 'the raw OBSERVED set' in DET-001 §10 / ADR-0005 §4 means: raw structurally-eligible live positives, NOT the naive presence of a keyword and NOT ignoring negation/attribution.

3. HARD-RISK OVERRIDES are computed FROM that raw live-positive set, per applicable rule/family. An active override can NEVER turn a structurally non-live occurrence into a live positive and can NEVER defeat structural negation/attribution.

4. GOVERNED SUPPRESS_INDICATOR effects are then EXECUTED (WP3 pre-match) at occurrence scope: an active, applicable suppressor neutralises only target-positive occurrences associated to it by at least one shared governed observation_ref. An associated otherwise-live/uncertain occurrence becomes FALSE; two non-empty disjoint ref sets are explicitly different occurrences and do not interact; if either occurrence lacks refs, association is unresolved and the otherwise-live/uncertain target occurrence becomes UNKNOWN, never global FALSE. Per-indicator occurrences then combine by three-valued OR (FALSE + TRUE = TRUE; FALSE + UNKNOWN = UNKNOWN). A suppressor is skipped only if blockable_by_overrides:true and an active override blocks its category; all directional suppressors here are false, so an override never rescues an associated occurrence. Suppression never resurrects or weakens a structural FALSE.

5. OVERRIDE-BLOCKABLE SOFT SUPPRESSORS (SUPPRESS_RULE / CAP_SEVERITY, blockable_by_overrides:true) are resolved by WP4: an active override BLOCKS these for its blocked categories (recorded as explanation); otherwise an active SUPPRESS_RULE cancels the rule and active CAP_SEVERITY caps its severity ordinally.
6. CONTEXT_ONLY indicators are recorded as benign evidence and never change the finding.
structural_semantics: There are TWO distinct concepts. (1) STRUCTURAL OCCURRENCE SEMANTICS — negation, reported/quoted/hypothetical attribution and non-live descriptive mood — are semantic properties of each normalized observation occurrence, resolved via observation_refs before overrides/suppression. They are NON-OVERRIDABLE and are not negative-library SUPPRESS_INDICATOR effects. (2) GOVERNED SUPPRESS_INDICATOR is a negative-library behaviour applied only between associated positive/negative occurrences through observation_refs; it never neutralises an explicitly different occurrence input-globally. Missing association is UNKNOWN. A hard-risk override can neither turn structural NON_LIVE into LIVE nor rescue an associated occurrence from a non-blockable suppressor.

overrides.name: Credential/QR+PIN demanded to RECEIVE money
overrides.does_not_block: NEGATION_DIRECTIONAL and BENIGN_CONTEXT effects (directional neutralisation and weak context) still apply.
overrides.rationale: NPCI/CERT-In: you never need a PIN or OTP to receive money.

overrides.name: Explicit request to disclose an OTP
overrides.does_not_block: NEGATION_DIRECTIONAL and BENIGN_CONTEXT effects (directional neutralisation and weak context) still apply.
overrides.rationale: RBI: institutions never ask for your OTP. A live disclosure request is hard-risk.

overrides.name: Payment demanded under arrest/legal/block threat
overrides.does_not_block: NEGATION_DIRECTIONAL and BENIGN_CONTEXT effects (directional neutralisation and weak context) still apply.
overrides.rationale: NITI Aayog digital-arrest: coercive payment demands are hard-risk.

overrides.name: Wallet connect to an unknown verification site
overrides.does_not_block: NEGATION_DIRECTIONAL and BENIGN_CONTEXT effects (directional neutralisation and weak context) still apply.
overrides.rationale: I4C CyberDost Trust Wallet drain chain.

overrides.name: Out-of-context Accessibility permission after app/link delivery
overrides.does_not_block: NEGATION_DIRECTIONAL and BENIGN_CONTEXT effects (directional neutralisation and weak context) still apply.

overrides.name: Screen-share/remote-control requested in a banking context
overrides.does_not_block: NEGATION_DIRECTIONAL and BENIGN_CONTEXT effects (directional neutralisation and weak context) still apply.
overrides.rationale: HDFC/NPCI: banks never ask you to install AnyDesk/TeamViewer. Blocks IT_SUPPORT_CONTEXT.
